# Indie Music India

> Free tools, data, and an artist development programme for independent Indian musicians. The focus is everything around the music: the economics, the identity, the network, and release strategy. Built by Siby John and Karishma Changroth.

Indie Music India (https://indiemusicindia.com) helps independent Indian artists understand and navigate the music business, without a label. It combines free, data-driven tools with a paid Artist Development Programme run by two consultants.

## Free tools
- [Radar](https://indiemusicindia.com/radar.html): live tracker of independent Indian artists, venues, and upcoming shows across eight cities, updated daily from public data.
- [Reviewer Database](https://indiemusicindia.com/reviewers/): 1,100+ blogs, podcasts, playlist editors, and curators covering Indian indie music, with direct submission contacts, reach scores, and pricing.
- [Labels and Agencies](https://indiemusicindia.com/industry/): 127 India-first record labels and booking agencies, with who is actively signing and what career stage to approach them at.
- [Resources](https://indiemusicindia.com/resources/): a start-here shortlist, a curated reading list, and the full 79-document toolkit of templates and checklists.
- [Artist Playbook](https://indiemusicindia.com/playbook/): 44 sections covering identity, production, distribution, revenue, live performance, venue booking, sync licensing, and rights registration, specific to India.

- [Streaming royalty calculator](https://indiemusicindia.com/tools/royalty-calculator/): a free tool to estimate what your streams are worth in rupees, by listener geography, platform (Spotify, Apple Music, JioSaavn, YouTube), and distributor cut.

## Answers and guides
- [Answers](https://indiemusicindia.com/answers/): 100 plain, India-first answers to the questions independent artists actually ask, on streaming royalties, distribution, releases, branding, PR, live, and rights.
- [How much does Spotify pay per stream in India](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/spotify-pay-per-stream-india/): how the payout model works, why India rates are lower, and how to estimate earnings in rupees.
- [How to make money as an independent artist in India](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/make-money-independent-artist-india/): the real income stack of live, sync, merch, YouTube, teaching, and fans.
- [How to get featured on Spotify editorial playlists in India](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/spotify-editorial-playlists-india/): pitching through Spotify for Artists and what improves your odds.
- [How to register music copyright and join IPRS in India](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/register-music-copyright-iprs-india/): copyright, IPRS, PPL, and master vs publishing rights.
- [The best music distributor for independent artists in India](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/best-music-distributor-india/): flat fee vs revenue split, India services, and keeping your rights.
- [A 12-week release plan for independent artists](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/12-week-release-plan-india/): a backward-planned release checklist.
- [How to build a fanbase in India (1000 true fans)](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/build-fanbase-1000-true-fans-india/): depth over reach and owning your audience.
- [How to create an electronic press kit (EPK)](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/electronic-press-kit-epk-india/): what to include and how to pitch it.
- [How to pitch your music to blogs and press in India](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/pitch-music-blogs-press-india/): finding the right writers and writing the pitch.
- [How to book live gigs as an independent band in India](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/book-live-gigs-independent-band-india/): building your draw and finding venues.
- [How to get sync placements in India (ads, film, series)](https://indiemusicindia.com/guides/sync-licensing-music-ads-film-india/): making tracks sync-ready and who to pitch.

## Programme
- [Artist Development Programme](https://indiemusicindia.com/programme/): Siby John and Karishma Changroth work directly with a small number of artists at a time. Start with one month, no commitment beyond that; the rate is shared on an intro call.

## About
- [About](https://indiemusicindia.com/about/): who is behind Indie Music India, why it exists, and the real economics of independent music in India.

## Key facts
- Founders: Siby John (13 years across YouTube India and LinkedIn, 400+ artists) and Karishma Changroth (Founding Member at Talented, Bangalore).
- Audience: independent musicians in India across nine languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Punjabi, Marathi, English).
- Cost to use the tools: free. Contact: sibyjohn0@gmail.com, WhatsApp +91 99600 25559.
